mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where the federal funds rate increases by more than 0.25% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to the potential economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where the unemployment rate increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A consistent decline in real GDP over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to decline.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where real GDP declines for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it indicates robust economic activity.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where industrial production increases by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, suggests a stable economic environment conducive to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL remains below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) both increase by more than 1% in a month, it signals a strengthening demand side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increase by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2%, signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200,000 and UNRATE decrease > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A consistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% for three consecutive months signals an accommodative monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as it encourages investment and borrowing.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS remains below 1% for three consecutive months.
